newsitem.title: UK: Centrica shares gain 7% to record level.
newsitem.headline: Centrica shares gain 7% to record level.

text.p: Shares in Centrica Plc rose nearly seven percent to a record high on Thursday amid switching out of BG Plc and following recent upbeat analyst comment on the stock, dealers and analysts said.
Centrica shares were up 5-1/2p at 86-1/4 by 0930 GMT after rising as high as 87p -- surpassing the previous peak of 84p set on July 16.
By contrast, BG was down 2p at 239-1/2 amid continued worries about a clash with industry regulator Ofgas.

A report in the Financial Times said relations between BG and Ofgas had deteriorated, with Ofgas accusing the company of breaking an agreement on how to deal in public with a Monopolies Commission report on pipeline charges.
Earlier this week, BG shares came under pressure as the market reacted to Ofgas price capping proposals which gave effect to the Monopolies recommendations.
Centrica was seen as insulated from such concerns.
"A number of people have been pushing the stock recently and there has probably been some switching out of BG," said Bruce Evers, analyst at Henderson Crosthwaite.
"It's no surprise to us that Centrica has got to a level which we would regard as fair value."
Dealers said SBC Warburg had been positive on Centrica shares, though market souces said it had not made any comment on the stock for about two weeks.
SBC Warburg analysts were not immediately available for comment.
